title: Buckwheat with Mushrooms
subtitle: and fried onion
description: Buckwheat cooked with fried mushrooms and onion, one of the tastiest ways to make it.

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a large pot. Add the finely chopped onion and fry for 2 minutes.
Add the chopped garlic, stir, then add the chopped mushrooms. Fry for about 5 minutes.
Add the rinsed buckwheat and the salt, stir and leave on the heat for another 2 minutes.
Add the water and bring to the boil. Lower the heat and cook for another 10-15 minutes, or until the water has evaporated.
Place a towel or paper towel over the top of the pot and cover with the lid.
Let the buckwheat rest in the pot for another 5 minutes, then serve.
